rules.infinite_in_degree: X_1(3,18) has only finitely many points of absolute degree 10
rules.sporadic: finitely many points of each absolute degree <= 10 on X_1(3,18)
rules.isolated: finitely many points of absolute degree 10 on X_1(3,18), so the point lies in no positive-dimensional family

points.reference: F. Najman, Torsion of elliptic curves over number fields of degree 10 (2026), https://hexagonmath.org/2611.00234v2, Proposition 11.18. Sporadicity: Derickx-Sutherland, Theorem 4.1; Najman-Varivoda, Table 1.
